content: Cristoʼbali, isguedgi bangusad
Degite, ¿igi an sogmalosunna? Bab-Dummad-anmargi-nabir-binsa-maid bur bule oyolegegala, ¿anmarde isgudii sadeguode? Suli, degisuli.
Ar anmarde isguedga burgwar-gudiyobidde, degite, ¿igi anmar bar isguedgi nanaosunna?
¿Ar be wissurmarsi? Bela anmar Cristo-Jesús-nuggi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaksamaladi, anmar Cristo-Jesús-burgwisadyob gunonimogad.

Ar anmar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaksadgi, anmar Cristo-burgwisadba burgwismogad, degi, eba diglesmogad. Adi, Cristo burgwarmalad-abargi-maigusadgi, degi, Bab-Dummad-ganguedba gannar durgusadgi, anmar san-binidgi dula-gudii gumogagar.
Ar anmar Cristo-burgwisadgi eba akanonikid, amba deyob anmar e-durgusadgi eba durgubalodo.
Ar anmar nue-wismalad. Anmar-san-isgudiid-osulolegega, anmar-sanburba-epennegwad Cristoʼba nakrusgi bioklesad, adi, melle bar isguedba anmar mailedii guegar.
Ar dule burgwisale, bato isgued geg bar oakaloged.
Ar Cristoʼba anmar burgwisale, anmar eba dula-gudigubaloed bensurdo.
Ar anmar wisid, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar durgusad, emi bar burgosulid, burgwed geg bar egi obined.
Ar Cristo burgwisgua, Cristoʼgi isgued-e-gangued degisadegu bergunonikid. Ar emi, Cristo dula-gudiidi, Bab-Dummadga dula gudisunnad.
Degisoggu, deyob be binsamarmosundo, isguedga an burgwar gudimarye. An dula gudiiddi, anmar-Dummad-Cristo-Jesúsʼba Bab-Dummadga an dula gudimarye.
Degisoggu, isgued be-san-sunna-berguedgi mer obined be imakmar, adi, galagwensuli-isgu-dule-saed-imakbiedba mer eba be damalagar.

Deginbali, melle be be-abaganmar ibmar-isgana-imakegala be imakmar. Bur be Bab-Dummad-urbaligwa be nanamar, dule-burgwis-gannar-durgusadyob be nanamar. Deginbali, be-abaganmar Bab-Dummadga ibmar-nuegan-imakega be imakmarbar.
Ar isgued bar bemargi obinosurmalad, ar ade, bemar Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba bar gudisurmalad. Bab-Dummad-nabir-dulemargi-binsamaid-igarba be gudimalad.
Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, igar-innikigwadba nanaergebed
Degitega, ar anmarde Moisés-Igar-Maidba bar gudisurmarsoggu, emidi, Bab-Dummad-dulemargi-nabir-binsamaid-igarba-gudimarsoggu, degite, ¿anmar isgumarsunnode? Suli, degisuli.

Ar dule-wargwen-sogedba be nanadiile, e-maiyob eba be ibmar-imakele, deyob-gudiidba be, we-dule-e-maiga be gunonidamalad. A-ulale, isgued-sogedba be nanadiile, be burgwemalodo. Ar Bab-Dummad-sogedba be nanaerdi, dule-innikigwadga be gumalodo.
Ar Bab-Dummadga anmar dog-nuedye sogsun. Ar iduar bemar isgued-maiga gudiinad. Emigindi, igar-nued-bemarga-soglesadba be napiragwadba nanadmalad.
Degidbali, be isguedgi ollorgunonimarsoggu, bemar igar-inniki-imakleged-e-maiga gunonimarsunnad.

An-bemarga-sunmaknaidi, amba bemar aku-itomarsoggu, sanar-sanar an bemarga sunmaknasunnad, adi, be magar itomalagar. Ar iduardi, bemar ibmar-isganaga be-abaganmar be ukdii gusmalad. Ar deyob-imakedi, aka bur bule-isguega be-imaked. Emisgindi, be, igar-innikigwad-maid-imakmalaga, deyob, be be-abaganmar ukmarbar, adi, be san-swilidik gumalagar.
Ar bemar isgued-maiga-gudimargua, bemar, igar-innikii-imaklegedgi bangus-gudii gusmalad.
Ar deyob gudimargua, degite, ¿ibi-nued egi be amismarsunna? Ar emigindi, egi be bingegudimarsunnad. Ar we-ibmarmardi unnila burgwedse dule-nied.
Emigindi, be isguedgi-ollorgunonimaladgi, Bab-Dummad-maiga be gunonimaladgi, bega we-ibmardi ibmar-nuedga gunonimalad, be san-swilidik gunonimarsunnad, adi, be burba-geg-bergued nikumalagar.
Ar isgued, burgwedgi dule-bennuked. Bab-Dummad-nabir-anmargi-binsamaiddi, anmar-Dummad-Cristo-Jesúsʼgi burba-geg-bergued anmarga uked.
